ACTION=A1

Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph toward a static obstacle located directly ahead at x = 16.6 m in the same lane. The drivable area is confined between y = -1.75 m and y = 1.75 m, and there is no adjacent drivable lane to bypass the obstacle. Therefore, the ego vehicle must decelerate to avoid a collision. Action A1 corresponds to braking/deceleration.
